atoms.text: My friends and I need more money than our pocket money. So we all have different side jobs to earn some extra money. I regularly babysit my cousins and my neighbour's children on the weekends. My friend Evelyn mows her neighbours' lawns. My friend Arthur delivers newspapers and my friend Hazel helps older people with their shopping.
